excerpt: Finally search your files by meaning. 100% local, 100% yours — I got tired of searching my own files and never finding anything. DocuBrowse fixes that — search by meaning, not just keywords, and it runs entirely on your machine. No cloud, no account, no per-query fee. Free, open source, GPL-3.0.

title: Vangrex
excerpt: Design, execute, and integrate AI workflows — Vangrex is a developer-first platform for building and running AI workflows visually. Design workflows on a visual canvas, connect AI models and tools, add logic and data flow, and execute them without building the orchestration layer from scratch. Use the Vangrex SDK to integrate your workflows into your own applications. 🚀 Vangrex is currently in private beta and we're looking for developers to try it, build real workflows, and help shape what comes next.

title: AlphaProxy.AI
excerpt: The One Gateway For Every Model, Agent and Workflow — AlphaProxy.AI is an intelligent orchestration layer that breaks down complex tasks into smaller, executable subtasks. It spins up ephemeral specialized subagents, assigns them roles in the main task, tools, skills, and dynamically selects relevant model per subagent from a Model Matrix of over 450+ open and closed LLMs and SLMs from 100+ providers. The result is execution with surgical precision, matching frontier labs' high quality at up to 70% cost reduction.

title: RepoHop
excerpt: Go between Grok Bot, Muse & others on the same local repo. — Grok Bot ran out of tokens mid-task and my friend couldn’t get to the code it was working on. So I built RepoHop using Vibekit.dev. Your repo stays on your computer while Grok Bot, Muse and other remote agents work on the same local working tree. When one agent gets stuck, switch to another and keep going. No cloning repos. No moving files. No starting over.

title: flowy 2.0
excerpt: professional recorder & editor, now featuring on-device AI  — The 2.0 update introduces on-device AI integration, Audio Transcription and professional editing tools such as dynamic camera layouts, in-depth animations, speed adjustments, captions, media & annotations.

title: Onefold
excerpt: Turn your design decisions into a DESIGN.md — Onefold turns your colors, type, shape, shadows and voice into one DESIGN.md that Claude Code, Cursor and Codex follow. Start from your website or one brand color, keep or change every suggestion, and export CSS variables or a Tailwind theme. Free, no signup.

title: JSONaire
excerpt: Open large JSON files on Mac without your machine choking — JSONaire is a native macOS app for opening and browsing huge JSON files, the kind that make Chrome DevTools, VS Code, or Electron viewers hang or crash. It memory-maps files instead of loading them into RAM, so a 4GB document opens in milliseconds and stays smooth at any depth. Includes native window tabs, fast search, copy in any format, and a table view for object arrays. Free up to 100MB, Pro unlocks unlimited size and all themes.

title: LucentraCode
excerpt: Code without the Clock — LucentraCode is an AI coding CLI built for developers who want powerful models without constantly worrying about usage limits or expensive subscriptions. Run it directly from your terminal, choose from models like GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, and more, and use them for real development work - debugging, building features, refactoring, testing, and working across larger codebases.

title: Bolt Forge
excerpt: Bolt's new agent with open-source models and 50X usage — Bolt Forge is a new agent inside Bolt.new that runs on open-source models. Every Pro plan gets up to 50X more usage with no daily caps. Scores 91% of Bolt's top paid model on their internal benchmark.
